rca of the issue: App.js declares the PDP route as `/product/:id` (existing convention shared by ProductCard, Home, etc.), but the three Phase-1 components introduced new hrefs of the form `/p/${product_id}` (per the spec) without a matching <Route> being added. React Router falls through to no element, producing a blank white screen with no 404 page. Verified by navigating to /p/prod-412d226517 (blank) vs /product/prod-412d226517 (PDP renders). Mitigation: either add `<Route path='/p/:id' element={<ProductDetail/>} />` to App.js, or revert the three new hrefs to `/product/${id}`. Recommend the former so the spec's URL contract is honoured.
